# arin_delegation (Resource)

A reverse DNS delegation, modified in place. Delegations exist per net and
cannot be created or destroyed; nameserver and DS changes take up to 24 hours to
reach the distributed DNS.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Zone name, without the trailing dot.
- `nameservers` (Set of String) Nameserver host names, matched exactly as ARIN
  stores them.

### Optional

- `delegation_keys` (Attributes Set) DS records. Omit to leave the server set
  untouched, configure (or set empty) to manage it. (see
  [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--delegation_keys))

<a id="nestedatt--delegation_keys"></a>

### Nested Schema for `delegation_keys`

Required:

- `algorithm` (Number) DNSSEC algorithm number.
- `digest` (String) DS digest, uppercase hex as ARIN stores it.
- `digest_type` (Number) DS digest type number.
- `key_tag` (Number)
- `ttl` (Number)
